description: Look up detailed information about any HTTP status code: class, name, description, cacheability, typical causes, and handling best practices. Covers every code in the IANA HTTP Status Code Registry (1xx-5xx, including 226, 425, 451, 508, 511 and the WebDAV codes) with its defining RFC; anything outside the registry is reported as `registered: false` rather than described. `cacheable` means heuristically cacheable by default per RFC 9110 §15.1.
name: http_status_lookup
